CustomField.label: Action Label
CustomField.description: Optional user-facing text for the action link displayed when this Check fails. Use a short verb phrase that describes the destination, such as "Review {!record.Name}" or "Create support case". Current-record merge tokens are resolved before display and may traverse relationships, for example {!record.Name} or {!record.Owner.Name}. Action URL controls whether the link appears. When Action URL is set and this field is blank, the link is labeled "Fix this".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional text for the failure action link, such as "Review {!record.Name}". Supports {!record.FieldName} merge tokens. Requires Action URL; blank uses "Fix this".
